description: This file defines the AdoNetGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface. It manages gateway list retrieval for Orleans clustering using ADO.NET, including initialization and fetching active gateways, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: AdoNetGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to provide gateway list management for Orleans using ADO.NET, with methods for initialization and retrieving gateways, and internal logging.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider by creating an instance of RelationalOrleansQueries.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active gateway URIs asynchronously, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property that returns the maximum staleness duration for the gateway list.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the gateway list provider is updatable; always returns true.
